stage_a_original_draft:
Let $\mathcal{I}$ be a cofiltered category. Let $i \mapsto X_i$ be a diagram
of topological spaces over $\mathcal{I}$. Let $X = \lim X_i$ be the limit
with projection maps $f_i : X \to X_i$.
\begin{enumerate}
\item Any open of $X$ is of the form $\bigcup_{j \in J} f_j^{-1}(U_j)$
for some subset $J \subset \Ob(\mathcal{I})$ and opens $U_j \subset X_j$.
\item Any quasi-compact open of $X$ is of the form
$f_i^{-1}(U_i)$ for some $i$ and some $U_i \subset X_i$ open.
\end{enumerate}
stage_b_substantive_review_note: Independent comparison with pinned Stacks source statement embedded in Stage A and validation of mathematical hypotheses, conclusions and quantified scope; no proofs/unmasked source read. For a cofiltered diagram and its inverse limit X, every open is a union of cylinder opens, and each quasi-compact open is a single cylinder open at some stage. Stage A changes J⊂I to the precise J⊂Ob(I), preserving both claims and their indexing.

stage_a_original_draft:
Let $\mathcal{I}$ be a cofiltered category. Let $i \mapsto X_i$ be a diagram
of topological spaces over $\mathcal{I}$. Let $X$ be a topological
space such that
\begin{enumerate}
\item $X = \lim X_i$ as a set (denote $f_i$ the projection maps),
\item the sets $f_i^{-1}(U_i)$ for $i \in \Ob(\mathcal{I})$ and
$U_i \subset X_i$ open form a basis for the topology of $X$.
\end{enumerate}
Then $X$ is the limit of the $X_i$ as a topological space.
stage_b_substantive_review_note: Independent comparison with pinned Stacks source statement embedded in Stage A and validation of mathematical hypotheses, conclusions and quantified scope; no proofs/unmasked source read. For a cofiltered diagram, if X has the set-theoretic inverse limit and the cylinder sets form a topological basis, then X has the universal property of the inverse limit in Top. Both premise (1) and (2) remain.

source_identity.original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-inverse-limit-quasi-compact}
Let $\mathcal{I}$ be a category and let $i \mapsto X_i$
be a diagram over $\mathcal{I}$ in the category of topological
spaces. If each $X_i$ is quasi-compact and Hausdorff, then
$\lim X_i$ is quasi-compact.

source_identity.original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-nonempty-limit}
Let $\mathcal{I}$ be a cofiltered category and let $i \mapsto X_i$
be a diagram over $\mathcal{I}$ in the category of topological
spaces. If each $X_i$ is quasi-compact, Hausdorff, and nonempty, then
$\lim X_i$ is nonempty.
